data_fields.name: event_loop_detect
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.5 cycle backwards step counts as a loop

data_fields.name: event_wrap_offset
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.001 cycle (previous set to current minus this)

data_fields.name: server_correction_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.1 cycle per update (inert in base class)

data_fields.name: animtime_interval_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.2 s (StudioFrameAdvance path, no caller in this file)

data_fields.name: old_event_id_floor
data_fields.donor_constant: 5000 (old event system ids below are skipped)

best_idea: Fire a clip's events (strike cue, dust, sound) on the update in which the playback crosses their cycle, so no event is missed between frames, and keep the gameplay strike on a server tick number instead of a client event.
decision_why: Crossing-based cue firing is frame-rate independent and fits the clip timeline (row 7), but the donor's events are client-only and it drops events in the first update after a loop wrap; Frankendom uses it for cosmetic cues only and fixes the wrap rule.
acceptance: A test steps a 0.5 s looping clip with an event at cycle 0.02 across a loop and asserts each event fires exactly once per pass (including on the update that wraps); in play the swing's sound and dust appear on the frame the cycle crosses them.
